title: Batman
description: Michael Keaton's Bruce Wayne takes on Jack Nicholson's villainous Joker. Gothic Gotham fantasy directed by Tim Burton. Violence/flashing images.

title: Batman Returns
description: Blockbuster action as Gotham braces itself for a showdown between the caped crusader, Catwoman and the Penguin.
